question: 按办公室统计 2015 年佣金收入，列出前 5 名
expected_sql: SELECT db.Office AS office, SUM(ft.Commission) AS commission_revenue FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades ft JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date dd ON ft.SK_CreateDateID = dd.SK_DateID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_broker db ON ft.SK_BrokerID = db.SK_BrokerID WHERE dd.CalendarYearID = 2015 GROUP BY db.Office ORDER BY commission_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

fibo_concepts.note: 佣金是经纪服务收取的费用
办公室是经纪机构组织内子单元
